text:
ashley: heads up — dedicated-ap-east GPU deck showing sustained mem pressure + rejects, queue len spiking
mike: same, p95 gen latency x3 for a few hosts, lots of 502/503s against model-v2
kai: checking infra telemetry — inter-pod fabric error counters climbing, kernel drops on host NICs
luis: TO RACK alerts from ap-east-1a, seeing 1.2% packet drop at the top-of-rack switches, vendor engaged
ashley: plan: bridge to hosted for low-priority traffic first. prefer gradual weight shift over 5m to avoid thundering herd
mike: suggest command (canary 10%):
```
route set --from dedicated:ap-east --to hosted:ap-east --weight 0.8 --window 300
```
sarah: can we throttle instead of full reroute? latency-sensitive customers might see regression
kai: throttling batching/window for non-SLA orgs will help. also reduce dedicated batch size to relieve mem pressure
ops-bot: action started — provisioning warm-hosted-pool size=40 gpus region=ap-east (job id: warm-8721)
ashley: initiating weight switch: 10% now, 50% at +2m, 100% at +5m if metrics stable. monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/infra/ap-east
mike: pushed 10% at t=0. watching error-rate and token-queue. current errors from dedicated nodes = 12% -> target <2%
kai: noticed KV cache cold misses on hosted after canary, enabling prefix-sync to reduce regen costs
luis: vendor updates — fabric micro-flap due to a failed ASIC on leaf-3 in ap-east-1a. replacement ETA ~18m
sarah: note on cost — hosted absorb will increase spend; FYI finance might need an explanation for the spike
mike: after 50% ramp, dedicated error-rate dropped to 3.1%, overall p95 back toward baseline
ashley: keeping hosted bridge until fabric stable. if not green at +30m we'll escalate for expedited hardware swap
ops-bot: incident created INC-20260304-1752 (link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260304-1752)
kai: follow-up remediation: plan to cordon + drain 3 affected nodes once traffic fully shifted, then run hardware tests
luis: scheduling hardware swap for leaf-3, patch window 3h for spare arrival; partial repair might restore capacity earlier
ashley: thanks team. I'll compile a short incident note and start a postmortem draft. monitoring until +1h then retro. :thumbsup:
